title: Leviticus Bible Quiz - Chapter 19
description: Ten questions on Leviticus 19: holiness in daily life, from harvest gleanings and fair wages to loving your neighbor and the stranger.

questions.text: What reason does Yahweh give in verse 2 for the command "You shall be holy"?
questions.explanation: Moses was to tell the congregation to be holy, because Yahweh their God is holy.

answers.text: Because the land belongs to Yahweh
Because Yahweh their God is holy

questions.text: What had to be done with peace offering meat that remained until the third day?
questions.explanation: The peace offering was to be eaten on the day it was offered and the next day; anything left until the third day had to be burned with fire.

answers.text: It was given to the priest
It was buried outside the camp
It was poured out at the altar
It had to be burned with fire

questions.text: For whom were the corners of the field and the fallen grapes of the vineyard to be left?
questions.explanation: The Israelites were not to reap the corners of their field or gather the fallen grapes, but leave them for the poor and for the foreigner.

questions.text: What does verse 13 say about the wages of a hired servant?
questions.explanation: The wages of a hired servant were not to remain with the employer all night until the morning.

answers.text: They must be paid at the end of each week
They must be paid when the harvest is in
They must not stay with you all night until the morning
They must be paid on the Sabbath

questions.text: Before whom must you not put a stumbling block?
questions.explanation: Verse 14 forbids cursing the deaf and putting a stumbling block before the blind.

questions.text: Instead of taking vengeance or bearing a grudge, what does verse 18 command?
questions.explanation: The Israelites were not to take vengeance or bear a grudge, but to love their neighbor as themselves.

answers.text: Leave the matter to the priest
Forgive him on the day of the Sabbath

questions.text: Besides cross-breeding different kinds of animals, which of these does verse 19 forbid?
questions.explanation: Verse 19 forbids cross-breeding animals, sowing a field with two kinds of seed, and wearing a garment made of two kinds of material.

answers.text: Building a house from two kinds of stone
Sowing a field with two kinds of seed

questions.text: When newly planted fruit trees bore fruit, in which year could the Israelites first eat it?
questions.explanation: The fruit was forbidden for three years, the fruit of the fourth year was holy for praising Yahweh, and in the fifth year they could eat it.

questions.text: Before whom does verse 32 say you shall rise up?
questions.explanation: Verse 32 says to rise up before the gray head and honor the face of the elderly.

questions.text: Why were the Israelites to love the stranger living among them as themselves?
questions.explanation: The stranger was to be treated like the native-born and loved as oneself, because the Israelites had lived as foreigners in the land of Egypt.

answers.text: Because the stranger was their brother
Because they had lived as foreigners in Egypt
Because the stranger also kept the Sabbaths
Because the land belonged to the stranger first
